three.js 0.180.0 (MIT), from the npm package `three`: build/three.module.min.js, build/three.core.min.js and examples/jsm/postprocessing/Pass.js (as addons/postprocessing/Pass.js). Unmodified. Loaded only when the walkable AI set opens; index.html maps the bare `three` specifier here.

Added for Vexcel 3D Cities tiles (Draco meshes, Basis/KTX2 textures) on the exteriors page, from the same
npm package `three@0.180.0`, unmodified: examples/jsm/loaders/DRACOLoader.js, loaders/KTX2Loader.js,
controls/OrbitControls.js, utils/WorkerPool.js, math/ColorSpaces.js, libs/ktx-parse.module.js (MIT),
libs/zstddec.module.js (MIT), libs/draco/gltf/draco_wasm_wrapper.js + draco_decoder.wasm (Google Draco,
Apache-2.0, see libs/draco/README.md) and libs/basis/basis_transcoder.js + .wasm (Binomial Basis Universal,
Apache-2.0, see libs/basis/README.md). Loaded only when a 3D city view opens.
